question: A warehouse holds 239 crates of oranges at the start of the day, in a building that also stores 500 pallets of unrelated furniture. Workers ship out 68 crates to a local market. That afternoon, a delivery truck brings in 66 more crates, after a loading job the driver said took 120 minutes, or two hours, door to door. The manager then decides to consolidate stock, multiplying every crate on the floor by 7 as she merges it with a sister warehouse's shipment. Another 61 crates arrive from a nearby farm. Finally, a citywide order comes in that quadruples the whole stock overnight. How many crates of oranges are in the warehouse now?

Pat had 133 cents in his pocket, spent 38 cents on a stamp, and then found 13 cents in the car. His cousin Quil had 5 times as many cents as Pat had at that point, so Quil was the richer of the two. Quil then earned 42 cents returning a shopping trolley and spent 579 cents on a book. Quil counts in cents rather than dollars, knowing that one hundred cents make a dollar. How many cents does Quil have left?

A teacher had 201 students across classes. She dismissed 157 leaving 44. A new program multiplied classes by 7 requiring 308 students. She moved 299 to electives. Those remaining doubled for evening sessions. How many students attended evening classes?

On Monday morning a school store held 226 boxes of pencils, and 62 boxes were sent over to the new building. In the afternoon every box left in the store was opened, and each one held 6 pencils. Those pencils were shared equally among the school's 6 classes. Each pencil comes with 4 spare leads in its case, and the school counts its supplies in single pencils rather than in boxes. How many spare leads did one class receive?

A business had 12 clients. They multiplied by 5 to 60. They added 64, reaching 124. They added 58 more, reaching 182. They multiplied by 9 to 1,638 clients. Her colleague has 50 clients (separate). How many clients total?

A musician had 67 sheet music pieces. They removed 49 pieces from the old repertoire. They divided by 3 to organize by difficulty. They added 80 pieces from new compositions. They added 56 pieces from a collection. They added 7 more pieces from practice materials. How many pieces were in the final repertoire?

A bakery began the morning with 4 identical ovens, each holding 58 rolls, combined into one batch. By midmorning, 128 rolls were sold to a wholesale client. A lunch rush made the remaining rolls grow to 5 times their size. Since the bakery weighs flour in ounces but sells rolls by count, the baker kept two separate ledgers. In the afternoon, 232 rolls were donated to a shelter. By evening, 156 more rolls were given away at a community event. Overnight, a final order made the remaining total grow to 6 times its size. How many rolls were ready by the next morning?

The town swimming club keeps all of its members in one register. There were 174 members in January, and 53 people joined in February along with 10 more in early March. In April 110 members let their membership lapse. A dozen lifeguards work at the pool. Over the summer 8 people joined in June, 45 joined in July and 57 joined in August. The main pool is 25 metres long. How many members does the club have now?

A warehouse manager organized boxes. Starting: 77 boxes. He multiplied by 2 to double the inventory. He subtracted 81 for shipment. He added 26 back. He added 57 more. He added 36 final boxes. How many boxes are in the warehouse?

Ana's allotment plot gave her 210 kilograms of vegetables last season, plus 20 kilograms of herbs. Her friend Bo's plot is far more productive: it gives 4 times as much as Ana's whole plot did in a season. Bo has 4 plots that each produce that amount, and each of them gives 4 harvests a year. How many kilograms do Bo's plots produce in a year?

The Ashwell juice plant began the week with 129 crates in its chiller, and a lorry delivered 13 more crates on Monday morning. The plant measures its juice in millilitres rather than in litres. Every crate in the chiller was packed with 9 bottles. A wholesale order took 902 bottles away on Wednesday, and 287 bottles were sold at the factory gate on Thursday. Each bottle still in the chiller on Friday was wrapped with 2 paper straws before going out. How many straws were used on Friday?

On Thursday morning a bakery split 201 sacks of flour equally between its 3 kitchens. Before lunch a mill delivered 12 more sacks to the first kitchen. Every sack in that kitchen makes 9 loaves. In the evening a partner bakery sent 55 finished loaves across to the same kitchen. How many loaves does the first kitchen have?

In the morning Jamal sold 50 tickets an hour for 4 hours for the school play. Before lunch 25 tickets were refunded, and 4 tickets were lost in the office and voided. In the afternoon the treasurer counted the sale as 3 dollars for every valid ticket. The play ran for ninety minutes, an hour and a half. In the evening Jamal paid 494 dollars of costume costs out of the ticket money. His co-organiser Kim raised fewer dollars than Jamal. How many dollars did Jamal have left after paying the costs?

A community garden tracked the total number of tomatoes harvested all day, starting with 96 tomatoes picked before dawn. By early morning, a bumper crop multiplied the tracked harvest by 7. By midmorning, a second row added 41 more tomatoes. By midday, a third row added 29 more tomatoes. By afternoon, volunteers tripled the tracked harvest by picking three more rows just like the first. By evening, a late pick added 53 more tomatoes. By night, a final gathering added 74 more tomatoes. A dozen volunteers worked the garden that day, though that number has nothing to do with the tomato count. How many tomatoes did the tracked harvest show by night?

A student had 130 items. They added 80 items. They multiplied by 5 times. They removed 1026 items. They tripled them. They removed 18 items. Someone had a dozen items. The time was minutes to hours. How many items?

A bookshop started the morning with 43 novels on a display table. A donation added 11 more novels. A promotional event doubled the table's total. A citywide festival made that total grow to 7 times its size. A regional order made it grow to 9 times its size again. A final gift added 33 more novels. How many novels were on the table after that gift?

A project tracked tasks morning, afternoon, and evening. Starting with 69 tasks, morning review removed 17 (52 tasks). Afternoon work multiplied by 7 (364 tasks). Late afternoon additions added 42 (406 tasks). For evening preparation, this was doubled (812 tasks). What was the evening task count?

A participant began with 108 points. They removed 27 through a penalty. Then added 23 back. They added 4 more. Then 52 additional points arrived. Finally, 76 more points were earned. They converted to hourly rates for tracking. How many total points accumulated?

On Monday morning the loading yard behind Priya's shop held 201 crates. Before lunch a haulier drove away with 184 of them. In the early afternoon Priya's neighbour Dev borrowed 14 crates for his own delivery, which left Dev holding more crates than Priya had. Later that afternoon 1 crate was found cracked and was burned. In the evening the depot swapped every crate still standing in the yard for 3 stackable crates of a newer design. Overnight each of those stackable crates was itself repacked into 4 shallow crates. How many crates were in Priya's yard once the repacking was finished?

A bakery made 211 loaves in the morning. By midday, they added 43 more. They doubled production for the afternoon shift—5 times the morning amount. That evening, they divided the total output in half for packaging. Each package was ordered 7 times over. How many packaged units were ordered?

Nadia had 51 friendship bracelets in her collection, while her friend Ines had 30 bracelets in hers. Nadia made 18 more bracelets over the weekend, a project that took '60 minutes, or one hour.' She then received 17 more bracelets as a gift. A friend gave her 44 more bracelets from an old collection. Finally, she made 7 more bracelets by hand. How many bracelets did Nadia have after making the last batch?
Two players combined 135 points. Player A removed 99. Player A added 9. Player A added 23. Player A removed 42. How many points does Player A have?
A shop started with 86 items. They removed 82 items. They added 19 items. They tripled. They increased 8 times. They divided by half. Finally, 20 items were removed. How many items do they have?
A factory had 153 units. They added 59. They removed 116. They multiplied by 9. They multiplied by 8. They added 56. They removed 1773. How many units?

A gym had 85 member files. They subtracted 77 inactive members. They multiplied by 9 for a membership projection. They subtracted 16 for cancellations. Then 31 more files were removed for cleanup. Finally, 21 files were archived. Recording daily, morning, and afternoon transactions, how many active member files remain?
